label: Чистый / Грязный
description: Oppositional adjective drill: чистый vs грязный across gender, number, contrast, and the comparatives чище/грязнее.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine agreement. 1. 'Чистый' matches the masculine noun 'пол'. 2. The ending is the masculine -ый. 3. 'Теперь' frames the clean result.
Strategic focus: Masculine contrast. 1. 'Грязный' takes the masculine -ый ending. 2. It agrees with 'пол'. 3. The direct opposite of чистый пол.
Strategic focus: Feminine agreement. 1. 'Чистая' matches the feminine noun 'рубашка'. 2. The ending shifts to the feminine -ая. 3. 'Белая' agrees in parallel.
Strategic focus: Feminine contrast. 1. 'Грязная' takes the feminine -ая ending. 2. It agrees with 'посуда'. 3. Dirty dishes, a common pairing.
Strategic focus: Neuter agreement. 1. 'Чистое' matches the neuter noun 'окно'. 2. The ending is the neuter -ое. 3. 'Блестит' shows the clean shine.
Strategic focus: Neuter contrast. 1. 'Грязное' takes the neuter -ое ending. 2. It agrees with 'пятно'. 3. A dirty stain, opposing the clean window.
Strategic focus: Plural agreement. 1. 'Чистые' matches the plural noun 'руки'. 2. The ending is the plural -ые. 3. Clean hands before the meal.
Strategic focus: Plural contrast. 1. 'Грязные' takes the plural -ые ending. 2. It agrees with 'ботинки'. 3. Dirty boots oppose the clean hands.
Strategic focus: Comparative mutation. 1. 'Чище' is the comparative of чистый. 2. The stem consonant mutates ст→щ. 3. 'Стало' marks a change of state.
Strategic focus: Comparative degree. 1. 'Грязнее' is the comparative of грязный via -ее. 2. No consonant mutation here. 3. 'Ещё' intensifies the comparison.
